name: zscn-theme-flip-dark-surface
description: ThemeFlip's Dark pane must resolve the dark surface tokens inside a light ambient theme (kata zscn)

mutation.declaration: styles/tokens.css: :root, [data-theme="dark"] { ... } (reverted the selector to :root only, dropping nested-dark-pane scoping from 8b06eb411)
mutation.note: Re-verified against the 2026-11-05 warm-paper palette. In an isolated frontend copy, baseline passed; removing only the nested dark selector failed all three dark probes: --surface-1 resolved to #FBF8F0 instead of #201F1C, pane background to rgb(244, 240, 230) instead of rgb(20, 20, 18), and surface probe to rgb(251, 248, 240) instead of rgb(32, 31, 28). Restoring the selector passed. Light custom-property and painted-surface probes remain unchanged in scope and strength.
